complexity_ledger.narrative: Workflow close of attribute-the-catch. The epic ships documentation and prompts: `references/bug_attribution.md` (the four record kinds -- CATCH, REACH, BLIND, PRICE), the two surfaces that ask for them at ticket close-out and workflow close, `prompts/regression_architecture.md`, and AT-04's clause-by-clause evaluation of six goals. MODEL DELTA IS ZERO AND THAT IS THE TICKET: no TLA+ action, variable or invariant was added, removed or changed, and `specs/current` was byte-identical to `specs/desired_program_model` on every semantic file at close. Six goals MET; one clause of GOAL-the-record-says-what-caught-it is DESIGNED, NOT APPLIED, because the 364-row ledger whose 27 out-of-vocabulary rows it would dispose lives on epic/stabilize-substrate and arrives with #296 -- stated in AT-04's RESULT.md as the epic's single largest limitation rather than worked around.
notes: NOTE: TLC reports incomplete; comparison skipped.

coverage audit (MF-026) is `not_run`: audit has not been run for this scope. RECORDED, NOT REFUSED (2026-08-04). The four oracles check fidelity of what is modeled and are bounded to it; unmodeled surface is invisible to all of them while they report green, and this is the only sweep that looks at it. Run `prompts/coverage_audit.md` if you want that read on this scope.

behavior_tests.evidence: Full suite at the close tip: 12 failed, 1613 passed, 23 skipped -- item for item the standing baseline, with no failure introduced by this epic. The 12 are pre-existing and four of them assert against a ledger that is not on main; see #296.

descriptor_comparison.evidence: `diff -rq specs/current specs/desired_program_model` differs only in README.md, spec_manifest.yaml status metadata, and the two planning files the close ignores by design (desired_state.yaml, ticket_plan.yaml). No semantic file differs.

tlc_after.evidence: specs/current/TlaSpecDevCli.tla with MC.cfg, run at close on 2026-09-06: "Model checking completed. No error has been found." 2,505,440 states generated, 124,643 distinct, depth 24, 0 left on queue, finished in 02s.

tlc_before.evidence: Not a separate run, and deliberately not presented as one. Model delta is zero, so the before-model and the after-model are the same file and one TLC run measures both. A second run of an unchanged model would be the same numbers wearing a different label, which is the shape that made the recycled evidence hard to spot.
